task: FM2612 Synth draft storage reconnect after IDBDatabase connection closes
cause: FM Files retained a raw IndexedDB connection indefinitely. A closed/closing connection caused subsequent transaction() calls to fail with InvalidStateError.
behavior: Existing database name, schema version, object store and current key are unchanged; no database reset or data migration.
Closed/version-changing connections are invalidated. A transaction-start InvalidStateError or aborted rollback retries the entire storage operation once on a reopened connection.
Transactions, including retry, are serialized. Detached snapshots retain FM/PSG/PCM editor state, binary files, Code and workspace/generation without replaying startup restoration.
Load and save resolve only after transaction completion. The synchronous tone recovery journal is cleared only after the matching workspace/generation/pending snapshot commits.
QuotaExceededError, DataCloneError and VersionError remain visible rather than being retried as connection failures. Failed opens do not poison future saves on an existing store.
An unrecoverable initial read disables autosave instead of writing defaults over an unread stored project. Cassette export remains available.
Frontend cache identities and the standalone Synth package include the readable new helper. CI runs the native IndexedDB fault-injection checker on the extracted package.
